test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-II (Held On: 08 Jan, 2024)
subject: general
question: What is the passage mainly about?

options.text: Preparing students for survival in the real world
Importance of teaching soft skills to students
The need to change the education system in 21st century
Participation of students in extra-curricular activities

solution:
The correct answer is** 'The need to change the education system in the 21st century.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage highlights that the traditional academic-only education model is evolving to incorporate a more comprehensive approach.
 
• The author emphasizes the importance of focusing on students' overall development, not just restricting them to classroom learning.
 
• It points out the significance of co-curricular activities, which contribute to the mental, social, and individual growth of students.
 
• The need for practical exposure such as guest lectures, industrial visits, and conferences is underscored as essential for understanding real-world industry workings.
 
• The combination of classroom teaching and practical experiences helps in building the overall personality of students and in teaching soft skills.
 
• Most professional colleges, including B-schools, have already started incorporating these practical experiences into their curriculum to support the all-round development of students.

Therefore, the correct answer is** 'Option 3'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1: Focuses solely on survival in the real world but misses the broader context of educational reform encompassing all development areas.
 
• Option 2: Soft skills are mentioned but are part of the holistic approach, not the main focus.
 
• Option 4: Participation in extra-curricular activities is discussed but is just one aspect of the need for change in the education system.
